dedupe_keys.name: cofactor residential dataset 2 sub metered hourly energy use risvollan housing association trondheim

description: COFACTOR-Residential Dataset 2, published by SINTEF from the COFACTOR project, contains hourly sub-metered energy use and weather data from the Risvollan housing association in Trondheim, Norway. The association has 1,058 apartments in 121 low-rise buildings built in 1972, with one to four bedrooms and 53 to 107 square metres of floor area (88.6 on average) and 1.8 residents per household on average. The buildings are on district heating for space heating and domestic hot water. There are 20 CSV files, one per heating central, each combining several buildings: a metadata section with building identifiers, construction year, floor area, numbers of buildings and units and heating system details, followed by time series of weather, main meter electricity and district heating, sub-meters such as heating, and smart meter electricity for 1,010 individual apartments. Coverage: one housing association in Trondheim, Norway. Access: open download from data.sintef.no without sign-in, with a README explaining codes. Licence: Creative Commons BY; free. Caveats: series length varies by file, at most 2017 to 2023, and the site is a single estate of one construction period. Simulation uses are calibrating residential heat and electricity demand models for cold climates and testing district heating and distribution grid load scenarios. Related records: none written on the day.
